name: The Pair
description: The Pair is a free, open-source AI pair programming desktop app that runs two AI coding agents on one task: a read-only Mentor that plans and reviews, and an Executor that writes code and runs commands. It connects straight to model endpoints over HTTPS, so there is no agent CLI to install.
featureList: Mentor and Executor dual-agent workflow: a read-only reviewer and a separate code writer
Cross-validated AI code review with a structured acceptance verdict (pass or fail, risk, evidence, next step)
Direct HTTPS connections to model endpoints over four wire protocols (OpenAI Chat, Anthropic, Responses, Command Code), with no agent CLI to install
Endpoint import from the configuration of opencode, codex, claude, kimi, pi, omp, gemini and killi, or from environment variables
In-app sign-in with a ChatGPT, Command Code, OpenCode Go or Muse Code subscription
Any model in either role, with independent reasoning effort for Mentor and Executor
Local models through Ollama for fully offline sessions
Git change tracking with inline diffs, and one git worktree per task
Per-turn token usage, estimated cost and request counts
Session recovery after a restart or crash
Optional plan gate and per-pair iteration cap that pause for human review
Stall detection: a warning after 120 seconds without output, stalled after 600 seconds
Interface in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean
